metadata.name: categories/devops-agent-product-questions
metadata.description: Questions about DevOps Agent product capabilities, security posture, compliance, performance tuning, journal access, or operational metrics, answered from AWS DevOps Agent documentation. Covers verify_aws_claim for claim-based and URL-based lookups of the DevOps Agent user guide (such as the aws-devops-agent-security page), and skill_read for loading the verity skill. Fixes re-fetching a documentation URL that is truncated at 10,000 characters of the page, which returns the same first part again, and output bloat from URL fetches. Records the claim-based query technique with topics reference_documentation and limit=3, and the skill_read plus verify_aws_claim parallel start. Read before answering questions about DevOps Agent features, security, privacy, data retention or compliance in a Chat session.

metadata.name: categories/privatelink-facts-and-limits
metadata.description: Looking up specific AWS PrivateLink factual data such as cross-region interface endpoint quotas, per-endpoint bandwidth limits, latency benchmarks between regions like us-west-2 and us-east-1, or recent feature announcements, without setup instructions. Covers verify_aws_claim for documentation and current-awareness lookups and skill_read for loading the verity skill. Fixes first queries that return general endpoint limits instead of cross-region specifics and broad latency queries with limit=5 that exceed 10K chars. Records topics reference_documentation for quota lookups versus current_awareness plus reference_documentation for recent launches, narrowing claims to a region pair, and the parallel skill_read plus verify_aws_claim start. Read before looking up PrivateLink quotas, limits, latency, or feature announcements in a Chat session.

metadata.name: categories/testing-mcp-servers
metadata.description: Testing or validating a custom MCP server added to the agent space, such as the searxng-mcp SearXNG search server, by confirming connectivity, tool availability and end-to-end functionality. Covers list_associations for discovering the MCP server configuration, gather_context and why delegating custom MCP tool tests to the Context Gatherer fails, and searxng-mcp_searxng_instance_info and searxng-mcp_searxng_web_search for connectivity and search tests. Fixes Unknown tool errors from unprefixed MCP tool names instead of the server-prefixed name, delegations that report success while every custom tool failed, and HTTP 429 Too Many Requests from the upstream SearXNG instance. Records the list_associations-first discovery pattern, the server-name_tool-name naming convention, and num_results=3 for light search tests. Read before testing or validating a custom MCP server in a Chat session.

Setting up cross-region AWS PrivateLink, such as interface endpoints between us-west-2 and us-east-1 or S3 access across regions, and editing the verity skill or AGENTS.md along the way. Covers verify_aws_claim, skill_read for verity and manage-skills, get_skill, update_skill, list_skills for knowledge_item_id, and list_agents_md, get_agents_md and update_agents_md. Fixes verify_aws_claim output over 10K chars with limit=5, loading one skill twice via skill_read and get_skill, and skipping verity; records limit=3 and topics values, the parallel verity start, and the list, get, update workflow for AGENTS.md. Read before answering PrivateLink setup questions or editing skills and AGENTS.md in a Chat session.
